dct_description_sm: Due to melting sea ice, it is much easier to hunt several fish species in the lower Northwest Passage. Currently, many Nunavummiut do not have enough access to reasonably priced, nutritious, safe, and culturally-relevant food. Having limited access to food is linked to health problems such as diabetes and childhood rickets. In this study we will monitor legacy organic pollutants and other contaminants as well as beneficial vitamin D; so that Nunavummiut can make informed choices about the food they eat. The purpose for gathering elemental data in the fish was to ensure that the fish were healthy for human consumption.
